content: 'Arani nuiwarimama
'Arani, Tseti, 'Enuxi,
Kainahani, Marareri, Kareri,
'Enuki, Matutsareni, Rameki,
Nuhexi. Nuhexi nuiwarimama (1Kem 1:5-23 – Tsut 10:2-31, 11:10-27) Nuhexi niwemama: Tsemi, Kami meta Kapeti.
Kapeti niwemama mepɨtetetewakai: Kumexi, Makuki, Marahi, Kawani, Tuwari, Metseki meta Tiratsi.
Kumexi niwemama: 'Atsikenatsi, Xipati meta Tukaxima.
Kawani niwemama: 'Eritsaha, Taritsi, Tsipɨre meta Xuranini.
Kami niwemama mepɨtetewakai: Kutsi, Mitsirahini, Puti meta Kanani.
Kutsi niwemama mepɨtetewakai: Tsewa, Kawira, Tsaweta, Xahama meta Tsaweteka. Xakama niwemama mekanakɨne: Tsawaha meta Rerani.
Kutsi Nimiruri paapaya kanayani, mɨkɨ tewi kwinimieme reuyutamiewetɨ kanayani 'ena kwiepa.
Mitsirahini wa'ukiyari kanayani rureutsixi, 'anameutsixi, rehawitsixi, natuhitsixi,
meta paturutseutsixi, katsurukitsixi meta katuritsixi mɨkɨ piritsiteutsixi wa'ukiyarima mepakɨ.
Kanani Tsiruni paapaya kanayani matɨarieya, meta Heti,
meta mepɨxiɨyarimamatɨkai kewutseutsixi, 'amuxeutsixi, keriketseutsixi,
heweutsixi, 'aratseutsixi, tsineutsixi,
'axiwareutsixi, tsemareutsixi meta kamatitsixi.
Tsemi niwemama: 'Erami, 'Atsuxi, 'Axipatsari, Ruri meta 'Arami. 'Arami niwemama: 'Utsi, Huri, Ketexi meta Metseki.
'Axipatsari Tseraki kanipaapayatɨkaitɨni, mɨkɨta 'Ewexi paapaya patɨa.
Meta 'Ewexi yuhutame yuniwema kaniwarayexeiya: mexɨakame Pereki pɨtitewakai, mɨkɨ 'utinuiwaku teɨteri yuxaɨta memeukuyaxixɨakɨ yayupapaɨmetɨ. Pereki mutaya pɨtitewakai Kutani.
Kutani 'Arimurari paapaya patɨa meta Tserepi, Katsaxi-Maweti, Yeraki,
Harurani, 'Utsari, Rikɨra
'Uwari, 'Awimaheri, Tsawa,
'Upixi, Kawira meta Kuwawi. 'Ikɨ yunaitɨ Kutani mekaniniwemamatɨni.
Tsemi nuiwarimama
Tsemi, 'Axipatsari, Tseraki
'Ewexi, Pereki, Xehu,
Tseruki, Nakuxi, Teraki
meta 'Apɨrami, 'Apɨrahami mɨtitewatatsiere.
'Apɨrahami nuiwarimama
'Apɨrahami niwemama: 'Itsahaki meta 'Itsimaheri.
'Itsimaheri niwemama: Newayuti mexɨakameya patɨa, Tseraxi, 'Ariweheri, Miwitsani,
Mitsima, Rumaha, Matsa, Haraha, Temaha,
Ketuxi, Napitsi meta Tserema. Mɨkɨ mepɨhɨkɨ 'Itsimaheri niwemama.
'Apɨrahami niwemama Tsetura muwarayexei 'iparewiwameya 'ɨyayatɨtɨ matɨa mepɨhɨkɨ: Tsimɨrani, Kutsani, Merani, Mariyani, 'Itsiwaki meta Tsuhaki. Kutsani niwemama: Tsawa meta Rerani.
Mariyani niwemama: 'Epa, 'Epexi, Kanuki, 'Awiraha meta 'Eriraha. Yunaitɨ mɨkɨ Tsetura niwemama mepɨhɨkɨ.
'Apɨrahami meta 'Itsahaki paapaya kanayani. 'Itsahaki niwemama mekanakɨne 'Etsahu meta 'Ixaheri.
'Etsahu nuiwarimama
'Etsahu niwemama: 'Eripaxi, Xehueri, Kehutsi, Karani meta Kure.
'Eripaxi niwemama: Temani, 'Umaxi, Tsepuhu, Katani meta Kenatsi, Timina meta 'Amareki.
Xehueri niwemama: Nakati, Tsera, Tsama meta Mitsaha.
Tsehixi niwemama: Rutani, Tsuwari, Tsiwehuni, 'Ahana, Ritsuni, 'Etsexi meta Ritsani.
Rutani niwemama: Huri meta Humani. Rutani Timina pɨtaruyatɨkai.
Tsuwari niwemama: 'Ariwani, Manakati, 'Ewari, Tsepuhu meta 'Unami. Tsiwehuni niwemama: 'Ayaha meta 'Ahana.
'Ahana nu'aya kanayani Ritsuni. Ritsuni niwemama: 'Amirani, 'Etsiwani, 'Itɨrani meta Kerani.
'Etsexi niwemama: Wirani, Tsawani meta Yakani. Ritsani niwemama: 'Utsi meta 'Arahani.
'Erumitsie te'aitamete
Te'aitamete 'ena memɨka'uxa 'Erumi kwieyaritsie mekateniuta'aita, 'akuxi 'ixaheritsixi ti'aitame mekahexeiyakaku: Wera Wehuxi nu'aya, kiekarieya Rinawa katinitewakaitɨni.
Kepauka mumɨ Wera, 'utɨmanata katiniuta'aita Kuwawi Tsera nu'aya, Wutsira kiekametɨtɨ.
Kepauka Kuwawi mumɨ, 'utɨmana katiniuta'aita Kutsani, mɨkɨ Temani kwieyaritsie pɨkiekametɨkai.
Kepauka Kutsani mumɨ, 'utɨmana katiniuta'aita Harari Werari nu'aya, mɨkɨ mariyanitsixi kaniwara'iwa Muhawi kwieyaritsie. Kiekarieya katinitewakaitɨni 'Awiti.
Kepauka Harari mumɨ, 'utɨmana katiniuta'aita Tsamɨra, Matsireka kiekame.
Kepauka Tsamɨra mumɨ, 'utɨmana katiniuta'aita Tsahuri, Xekuwuti mɨrakutewatsie kiekame 'Eupɨrate hatuxameyari tetsita.
Kepauka Tsahuri mumɨ, 'utɨmana katiniuta'aita Wahari-Kanani 'Akuwuxi nu'aya.
Kepauka Wahari-Kanani mumɨ, 'utɨmana katiniuta'aita Harari. Kiekarieya katinitewakaitɨni Pahu, 'ɨyaya Mehitaweri pɨtitewakai, Matereri nu'aya meta Metsawi teukarieya.
Kepaukata Harari mumɨ, 'Erumi kwieyaritsie mekateniuta'aita 'ikɨ 'itsɨkate: Timina, 'Ariwa, Keteti,
'Ahuriwama, 'Eraha, Pinuni,
Kenatsi, Temani, Miwitsaxi,
Makirieri meta 'Irami. 'Ikɨ 'itsɨkate mekanakɨne 'Erumi kwieyaritsie.
